surface_name: Contacts lookup and upsert by email
title: HubSpot GET contact by email returns 404 even though the contact exists
symptoms: SDK getById with an email returns not found
Batch upsert by email rejects a partial update
cause: The object path segment is treated as the record id unless idProperty=email is passed. Batch upsert keyed on email also does not support partial upserts.
fix: Pass idProperty=email on single and batch reads, and for upserts that only touch some properties use a custom unique property as the key.
affected: HubSpot CRM contacts v3; getById signature as in @hubspot/api-client 14.0.1, as of 2026-10
